question: India is home to the second oldest cricket club in the world. Where is it situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The second oldest cricket club in the world is the Calcutta Cricket Club, located in Kolkata (formerly Calcutta). It was founded in **1792**. 
 
• The **oldest** cricket club in the world is the **Marylebone Cricket Club (MCC), established in 1787 in England. **
